verification.precondition: The canonical v2 protocol declares two complete ordered atomic refreeze edge sequences and a reachable session supplies exact per-machine state occurrences.
verification.stimulus: Replay canonical T04-to-T03 refreeze, arbitrary duplicate T29 self-loops, and an extra-edge refreeze candidate through whole-session semantics.
verification.expectedSemanticState: The complete manifest-declared sequence is accepted; every other repeated-machine edge list is rejected.
verification.expectedEvidenceState: The runner reports the literal assertion: only complete ordered protocol-declared atomic edge sequences may repeat a machine
verification.forbiddenMutation: No local validator constant, partial sequence, arbitrary self-loop, reordered sequence, or extra edge may substitute for the exact canonical protocol declaration.

behavior: a repeated-machine commit must equal one complete ordered atomic edge sequence declared by the canonical protocol manifest
